findings.summary: Assignment-scope mode required classifies tenant-wide role and permission grants as orphaned while Access still allows them.
findings.failure_scenario: Panel scopes are AssignmentScopePolicy::required (inherit semantics, dossier 09 P4). User 2 has only a project-2 seller grant, so Authorizer::decide(client 6 in project 5, clients.view) is not_granted. A stored tenant-wide auditor grant (context_type NULL, scope_required false) or a stored tenant-wide clients.view grant makes that decision granted, and GrantManager::page(state: orphaned) returns that id while page(active) does not. The same permission row is active when the panel mode is inherit.
findings.reproduction: PHPUnit on AzGuard\Tests\TestCase with CrmWorld::seed and W::panel(scopes: AssignmentScopePolicy::required(ProjectScope)). Output: baseline decide(user 2, client 6, clients.view)=[false, not_granted]; after ManagerWorld::stored('role','auditor',2) id role:6, decide=[true, granted], page(orphaned,subject user 2)=[role:6|auditor|global], page(active)=[role:4|seller|crm.project]; mutation-delete+touch of role:6 returns not_granted; after stored('permission','clients.view',2) id permission:1, decide=[true, granted], page(orphaned)=[permission:1|clients.view|global]. Recompile to inherit: decide=[true, granted], page(orphaned)=[], page(active) contains permission:1|clients.view. Cause: knownRoles sets global only when mode !== 'required' (line 151), and knownPermissions omits OR context_type IS NULL when mode === 'required' (lines 205-207). Access sourceScopes still reads the global context for mode required.
findings.suggested_fix: Treat a null context as known whenever the role is not scope_required, including mode required, and always accept a null context_type for a known permission grant. Leave scope_required roles with a null context orphaned.

checked: Partition is fixed in PanelManagers::for; find/page/update/revokeMany use that panel, tenant and origin; revokeIds resolves every id under the panel lock before apply and a foreign id throws with no write; cursor digest binds panel, tenant, origin, filter and build, and the keyset id stays inside the SQL partition.

FormerKeys migration reads locked stored rows, requires a grantable destination whose formerKeys contain from, preserves id/scope/subject/origin/expiry/fields on a move, and on collision keeps the destination row, takes max expiry with NULL winning, and deletes the source; withUntil/withFields are refused; planRoleKeyMigration takes the lock and does not run pipes, journal, touch or events; RoleGrantUpdated.previousRole and RoleRevoked carry the old key.

Inherit-mode orphan cases (unknown, former, NotGrantable, unbound or removed scope, PolicyOnly exact, pattern covering no Grants key, roles-only permission rows) follow Access; whereNot(Closure) compiles as AND NOT (...), and the global-context NULL branch is explicit.
update, revokeMany and migrateRoleKey all enter Storage::mutate, which locks panel_state before the plan; fingerprint is GrantRows::record on both the primary inspection session and LockedReads.
RoleCatalog, GrantManager and PermissionManager match 05 §2 and D18, are readonly/final where specified, and GrantFilter/GrantPage are the only new Changes values on the zone allowlist.

F1.evidence: Own run: panel scopes required(ProjectScope); stored tenant-wide auditor grant of user 2 → Authorizer granted while page(orphaned) listed it. Cause: GrantInspection mirrored the write validator (mode required refuses a new tenant-wide grant) instead of what Access reads.

correction: GrantInspection: tenant-wide role grant known unless the role is scope-required, tenant-wide permission grant always known; panel scope mode no longer used. Regression test OrphanCleanupTest 'follows Access on a panel that requires a scope' (positive grant/revoke controls; negative control: mode-based classification fails it). Affected checks V1, V2, V7–V12 rerun green (artifacts/P5.3-execution/after-review-fix).
outcome: one owning correction; no re-review run
